mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with an air quality index of 52. Under the New Moon tonight, the ISS passes overhead, though you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 63 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has formally adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous council vote, establishing a long-term vision for our neighborhoods, housing, and local economy. Additionally, residents are encouraged to stay connected to city projects by subscribing to the latest digital newsletter.

We have a busy week ahead starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Looking further, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee on October 13, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and various trivia options on October 14.

In a report covering September 28 through October 5, officers responded to a noteworthy incident on October 3 where a 19-year-old man was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following an investigation involving the Cottage Grove Police Department.

Today's delicious flavor was Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. As the store is now closed for the evening, please look forward to tomorrow's flavor, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, which will be ready for you when the store opens tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
